name: Chicken Caesar Salad with Roasted Broccoli, Tomatoes & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: Transfer broccoli to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing broccoli halfway through, until fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces and add to the bowl. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done, remove from the oven and let cool, about 5 minutes.
Add roasted broccoli, Parmesan, almonds, and dressing to the bowl with the chicken. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
⅓ cup almonds, sliced
¾ cup Caesar dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
